title: Intractable probabilistic computations in maximum likelihood estimation
description: Deep generative models have been limited by the difficulty of approximating many intractable probabilistic computations that arise in maximum likelihood estimation and related strategies.
canonical_description: maximum likelihood estimation for deep generative models requires approximating intractable probabilistic computations

evidence.quote: Deep { generative} models have had less of an impact, due to the difficulty of approximating many intractable probabilistic computations that arise in maximum likelihood estimation and related strategies
